pr.title: Fix #1905: /sdlc auto-resolves phase_gate follow-ups from context
pr.description: Fixes #1905. Adds a session-scoped `resolved_questions_map` to the /sdlc skill's Phase 4 (HITL) so that draft-embedded answers collected during a `phase_gate` are reused when the orchestrator subsequently registers the same questions as standalone `choice`/`feedback` decisions — instead of re-prompting the user for each one. Skill-only change (Option 1 from the issue); orchestrator protocol is untouched. Every auto-resolution produces a one-line user-visible note so an incorrect match is catchable.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: none — the change is markdown-only (skill behavior spec, no code).
- Manual: run `/sdlc <issue>` against a refiner output that embeds multiple `<!-- egg-hitl-decision id=decision-N -->` markers (issue #1901 is a known reproducer). Verify:
  1. Step 5 surfaces all draft-embedded decisions once, and the skill internally records them in `resolved_questions_map`.
  2. After the phase_gate clears, each follow-up `choice` decision whose question matches auto-resolves (prints a `Auto-resolved <decision_id>: selected '<option>' from captured context.` note) without re-prompting.
  3. A `feedback` group with partially-matching questions prefills the matches and only prompts for the unmatched questions, then submits a single merged `provide_input`.
  4. A follow-up decision whose question was rephrased / doesn't match any captured answer still prompts the user normally.
  5. A captured answer that doesn't correspond to any option in the registered decision falls back to prompting.
